description: Plan de voirie - Portes cochères is a dataset listed in Paris Data open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Direction de la Voirie et des Déplacements - Ville de Paris. Passage de Porte Cochère - Représentation de la surface occupée sur le trottoir par le passage de porte cochère. Tous les P.P.C matérialisés sur le trottoir sont à créer, y compris ceux qui ne donnent pas lieu à un accès véhicule. Un P.P.C peut être localisé devant une voie privée ou sur un terre-plein. Coverage: Paris. The portal files it under Mobilité et Espace Public. Its keywords are PVP, PPC, trottoir, bâtiment, DVD. The portal shows 33,914 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-10 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODbL-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-paris-fr-portal.
